body_markdown:
### What’s New in October 2026


This month’s Data Studio updates make search more powerful, help you get started with assisted labeling sooner, and make project results easier to review and export. Highlights include Advanced Search and saved searches in row labeling, Predictive Labeling with an LLM, Labeling Agents for new documents, and merged exports.


### Data Studio


#### Advanced Search in Row Labeling: Find Matching Answers with Multiple Conditions


Advanced Search is now available for row-based projects. Combine conditions to narrow your results, then scan a clearer results layout that highlights answers matching those conditions.


[Learn more](https://docs.datasaur.ai/advanced/extensions/search#row-labeling)


#### Saved Searches in Row Labeling: Reuse Search Criteria without Starting Over


You can now save searches in the Row Labeling Search Extension and return to them when you need the same criteria again. This makes recurring review and filtering tasks easier to pick up.


[Learn more](https://docs.datasaur.ai/advanced/extensions/search#saved-search)


#### HTML in the URL Viewer: Render HTML Code as a Webpage


You can now view full HTML code as a rendered webpage in the Row Labeling URL Viewer, giving you another way to work with HTML-based content.


[Learn more](https://docs.datasaur.ai/data-studio-projects/lets-get-labeling/row-and-document-based#row-based-with-url-view)


#### Predictive Labeling: Start Getting Suggestions with LLM


You can use Predictive Labeling with a few labeled examples using LLM as provider, even before you’ve labeled any rows in the project. Once configured, the provider becomes the default, helping you get started with suggestions sooner.


#### Labeling Agents for New Documents: Assign Agents During Document Addition


When you add documents to a project, you can now assign Labeling Agents in the Add Documents wizard. Selected agents work on the newly added documents while existing agents keep their current scope.


#### **Merged Project Exports: Combine Multiple Project Files into One**


The Export All Files dialog now offers an option to merge multiple export files from a project into a single file for supported formats. This makes it easier to handle exported results across Row Labeling, Datasaur Schema, and other labeling types.


[Learn more](https://docs.datasaur.ai/data-studio-projects/export-project#merge-all-files-into-a-single-output)


#### More Accurate Audio Metrics: Exclude Transcription Segments from Label Totals


Transcribe Audio timestamp segments are no longer counted in “Total Labels Applied” and related label metrics. That gives you a more accurate picture of content annotations in audio projects across analytics, reports, and related summaries.


#### Labeler Performance Summary: Review Individual Analytics When a Project Is Complete


A new workspace setting lets labelers view their own performance analytics. When a project they worked on is completed, they can also receive a notification with a direct link to their performance page.


[Learn more](https://docs.datasaur.ai/workspace-management/analytics/my-labeling-performance#enable-labeling-performance-visibility)


#### Metadata Search in Span Labeling: Find Values with Prefilled Search and Suggestions


In the Span Labeling Editor, you can right-click a metadata value to open Advanced Search with its key and value already filled in. Suggestions in the value field also help you find metadata values faster.


We’re continuing to make everyday labeling and review workflows clearer and easier. Stay tuned for what’s next!
